notes.title: Big Update
notes.content:
[b]A few big features were added, as well as some quality of life features and bug fixes. This update was composed of community and playtesting feedback.[/b]

[h1]1. Added map selection for Arcade mode.[/h1]
You can now choose whatever map you want to play on. We will continuously be improving the maps, and adding new ones.

[h1]2. Menu improvements and redesigns.[/h1]
The UI in all the menus have been updated to look and work better. Beans will drop down once you join a room, one bean for each player, and the beans will have the assigned players username above them. This was added for the coolness factor. This meu and all other UI will continue to be improved.

[h1]3. The AI bots have been fixed and improved.[/h1]
Many game breaking bot related bugs have been fixed. So if you have an empty room, you can still play with the bots. The bots have also had some minor bugs fixed, and have generally been improved. The bots will continue to be improved.

[h1]4. The games tutorial has been turned into a actual tutorial.[/h1]
There is now a actual tutorial that you can use to learn the game. If you don't know how to play, or the game seems boring, USE THE TUTORIAL!

[h1]5. Steam images and displays have been updated.[/h1]
Our game has a few new images, specifically in your library.



[b]If there is anything that is broken, needs fixing, needs improved, suggestions, or anything else, feel free to put it in our community page or reach us through email.[/b]
